### Framing Requirements

- **Mandatory framing?** Yes (soft)
- **If yes, what kind?** Manuscripts must demonstrate **person-environment relation** contribution.
- **Consequences of ignoring it**: Manuscripts redirected to general-psychology or environmental-science venues if env-psych contribution unclear.

## Strategic Notes

### Hard Blockers

- Manuscripts outside env-psych scope
- AI use without disclosure per Elsevier
- Pure environmental science without psychology theory

### Soft Tax

Low for env-psych tradition. Cross-disciplinary accessibility valued.

### Best Suited For

- Place attachment empirical research
- Pro-environmental behavior change studies
- Restorative environments / nature psychology
- Climate psychology and sustainability behavior
- Urban design and environmental affordances
- Mixed-methods place studies

### Not Recommended For

- Pure environmental science (consider env-science venues)
- General psychology without env angle
- Pure architecture without psychology theory

### Rejection Fallback Chain

| Rank | Journal | Why this fallback works |
|------|---------|------------------------|
| 1 | *(Environment and Behavior — community contribution welcome)* | SAGE peer; env-psych specialty |
| 2 | [Health Psychology](./health-psychology.md) | If health-environment angle |
| 3 | *(Frontiers in Psychology env-psych section — community contribution welcome)* | OA alternative |

**Reverse direction** *(optional)*: If your paper was rejected from general-psychology as "too environment-focused," J Env Psych is the Elsevier home for place / behavior / design psychology.
